mentions.name: Symbiote
mentions.description: Fully programmable workout tracker (part of the same ad-free, subscription-free stack), positioned as a completely free, no-ads alternative to BoostCamp; supports built-in programs such as GZCLP.
mentions.source_excerpt:
Symbiote App - Think "BoostCamp" but completely free, no ads, and fully programmable workout tracker

Example of GZCLP:
https://symbiote-studio.macrocodex.app/?builtin=gzclp
